capabilities: capture tasks into a selected Markdown task note and index additional task notes
organize tasks under registered project headings without moving them
plan scheduled work in calendar, monthly planner and timeline views
manage recurring task series and safe cross-note moves with source-aware undo
run project, date or priority kanban boards and a local pomodoro timer
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README emphasizes privacy: no network calls or telemetry. Manual installation only via copying dist files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in hub for capturing, planning and reviewing tasks across notes while keeping them as plain Markdown checkbox lines.
summary: Markdown-native task hub that captures tasks into chosen notes and offers dashboard, calendar, kanban, planner, recurring and pomodoro views.
